subject: OTLP mapping triage & scope — Datadog + Grafana alignment
messages:
From: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@datadog.com>, Elena Morozova <elena@grafana.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 09:10:00 -0700
Subject: OTLP mapping triage & scope — Datadog + Grafana alignment

Hi Sanjay / Elena —

Thanks for agreeing to partner on the OTLP compatibility checks. We want to run a focused triage to identify:

- required field-remapping (span/service/trace ids, host/service tags)
- metric/label normalization we should surface in Redwood Optimize
- any ingestion or sampling caveats that would affect our benchmarked latency/cost numbers

Attached: triage_agenda.pdf (10m meeting + owners) and a field_mapping_template.xlsx to capture concrete examples.

Proposed 45m slot this week: Tue or Wed afternoon PDT. Please ping back with a preferred time and the engineer(s) who should join. Our suggested agenda: quick architecture alignment -> two sample payload walkthroughs -> next steps + action items.

Ben and Jordan are looped in to capture notes and own the demo. Connor will join the live run-through.

Thanks — looking forward to a practical session.

—Lauren
Lauren Bishop
Head of Partner Integrations | Redwood Inference
lauren@redwood.com

Attachments: triage_agenda.pdf (PDF), field_mapping_template.xlsx (XLSX)
From: Sanjay Patel <sanjay@datadog.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Elena Morozova <elena@grafana.com>
Cc: Maria Chen <maria@datadog.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jul 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: OTLP mapping triage & scope — Datadog + Grafana alignment

Hi Lauren —

Thanks for the clear agenda. Maria (cc'd) will be our traces/metrics SME for this. We can do Tue 2:30–3:15pm PDT or Wed 4:00–4:45pm PDT — Tue is slightly better for our infra folks.

A couple quick notes ahead of the call:
- Datadog has a single-field approach for service.name vs. resource.service; we often map resource.service -> service.name on ingestion which affects attribution.
- High-cardinality labels on metrics are subject to sampling/rollup on ingestion; we'll highlight examples during the walkthrough.

We'll populate the field_mapping_template with a few examples before the call.
